name: Oji
source:
Kazuya's uncle, Chigusa's husband, and Hikari's father. He has no name given, Oji simply means 'uncle'.

[spoiler] Since Kazuya and Hikari's true father is Akira, Oji is unrelated to both.[/spoiler]
